_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of an ancient town situated on the
 right bank of the Yamunā, the birth-place of Kṛṣṇa and the scene
 of his amours and exploits; it is one of the seven sacred cities in India
 (see {#avanti#}), and is, to this day, the favourite resort of thousands
 of devotees. It is said to have been founded by Śatrughna; {#nirmame#}
 {#nirmamo'rTezu maTurAM maDurAkftiH#}

 <ls>R. 15. 28</ls>; {#kalindakanyA maTurAM gatA'pi gaNgormisaMsaktajaleva BAti#} <ls n="R.">6. 48</ls>.
